title: 诊断输出与账号信息泄漏验收
scope: Independent red-action acceptance of the existing request-log, credential and account-profile modules: accurate leakage scope for password/token/Authorization/cookie/user paths, retained status/system error/offset/HTTP status/request line, account isolation, scanning after the worker exits, and no access to real user credentials.

not_exercised: Windows Credential Manager UNAVAILABLE: not induced by this job. J21 documented that a low-integrity process, a stopped VaultSvc and an S4U task all remained available; the mapping of those platform errors to UNAVAILABLE is unproven here and stays pending.

Real user credentials are never read: the Windows job uses a random test namespace in the CI runner account and deletes only its own records; the Linux job uses a private D-Bus, a temporary HOME and a test collection.
rounds_note: Three failed rounds were defects inside this package's own new tooling, not owner or product defects: 40214797350 (guard compared the frozen-SDK tree from the freeze commit and the detector control inverted its own polarity), 40214912182 (Linux verified the wrong phase, the OPDS request diag reused the module's http status name, Windows fixtures were written in text mode and became CRLF), 40215199931 (an edit inserted bare comment lines into runner.py and the aggregator read an undefined job variable). The fourth run repeats the full assertion set on bbba06e3 and is green. This exceeds the nominal three-round budget; no assertion was relaxed and no failed artifact was deleted.

failures.cause: frozen-SDK tree diff taken from the freeze commit (mainline CMakeLists history is not this package's change); detector positive control inverted

Linux invoked verify-clean instead of verify-unavailable-clean; the OPDS request diag reused the module status name http so the judge read code 8 against http_status 500; Windows wrote the VERSION/FORMAT documents in text mode and CRLF broke the canonical shape
runner.py IndentationError from a mangled comment block; the aggregator also read an undefined job variable (never reached)
